[USER] The user asked about blending tools and expressed uncertainty about what tortillons are.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained that blending tools are small, cylindrical tools made of compressed paper or felt, and that tortillons are a type of blending tool made of rolled paper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised that while using a finger to blend is possible, it can transfer oils and cause smudging.
